title: An overriding method must not narrow a parameter type via PHPDoc

ground_truth.statement: BaseValidator::validate() accepts (mixed, Constraint). LengthValidator::validate() keeps the native signature (mixed, Constraint) so PHP allows the override, but narrows @param to (string, LengthConstraint) and relies on those narrower types. A caller holding BaseValidator that passes 123 or a base Constraint triggers TypeError / Error at runtime, proving the PHPDoc narrowing violates parameter contravariance.

phpstan.reason: In this baseline configuration PHPStan deliberately suppresses maybe-compatible PHPDoc override checks: reportMaybesInMethodSignatures defaults to false. MethodSignatureRule emits method.childParameterType for this narrowing only with that optional flag enabled.

notes: Counterpart to assignability/docblock-return-covariance. Psalm 6.20.1 (MoreSpecificImplementedParamType) and Mago 1.60.2 (incompatible-parameter-type) both report the narrowed @param override. PHPStan 2.3.1 is silent at baseline level 9 because reportMaybesInMethodSignatures defaults to false (conf/config.neon:100), and emits method.childParameterType when enabled.
